notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug through which the no deaths achievement was always being triggered when completing level 1
[*] Fixed a bug through which no achievements were being triggered upon completion of level 5
[*] The game now detects the Steam GUI language to set the default upon launch
[*] Room 07 now works as intended

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Fixes:

• Fixed some computers not being able to spawn items.
• Fixed a problem with the checkpoints in L4.
• Fixed some visual glitching in L1/L3.

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Fixes:

• Revamped Font design in order to better accommodate all languages.
• Simplified Level 4's structure, in order to streamline the gameplay:
   - The main shortcut is no longer available, in order to avoid confusion in the players.
   - Simplified room 113.
• Solved a bug where if an arrow key was pressed at the same time as either the A or D key, the character got stuck in an animation loop.
• Fixed some Z-Fighting issues.
• Improved Lighting and performance in Level 4. 
• Improved Control Prompts in Level 1
• Deleted unused words and letters in Level 1.

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Fixes:

• Fixed Achievements getting unlocked without being deserved (Congrats to those who beat us!)
• Solved an issue on Level 2 where Water wouldn't spawn after quitting the game.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Fixes:

• Improved performance in certain levels.
• Corrected leftover placeholder in Credits.
• Removed duplicated collectible.
